verdicts.reason: A: the 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' eyebrow and the italic subtitle are stranded at the far right, away from the headline they introduce, and the missing-asset placeholder collides with the subtitle. The RSVP button is just another pill in the badge row, so the CTA is buried, and the URL and time copy are tiny and scattered. B has the same problems: RSVP is lost among the badges, the URL and time block in the right column is microscopic with an orphaned 'Pier 9', the subtitle is squeezed in beside the badges, and the placeholder crowds the bottom-right corner. B edges ahead only because the headline, date and pill row form one centred block, and the eyebrow at least sits with the logo.
